title: Open my file, get a right drawing

screens.caption: A clean file opens on the Data page with its guessed roles as property rows, a view-only preview, and Load focused.
An unsure file marks only Name and Weight; the Name dropdown is open and the hovered choice lights its columns in the preview.
The graph is drawn with gene names, a counts chip on the canvas and one source row in the list beside it.

title: See what loaded, fix what is wrong

screens.caption: The Data page panel opens with summary rows, kind chips and a Warnings section, one row per kind of problem with its count and action.
Right-click a column row: Change type shows how many values convert and how many go blank before it applies.
Toolbar Filters opens a small popover over the canvas that starts with a column list; steps and sets stay on the Data page.
One condition row, padj < 0.05, with a live chip of 60 of 318 nodes and Show only or Highlight; the canvas previews it.
Only the 60 matching nodes are drawn, the toolbar's Filters shows 1, the list beside the graph shows the filter, and the table shows 60 rows.

title: Join a second file onto this graph

screens.caption: A second file dropped on the graph opens the Data page with Join pre-chosen: the match row, match chips, a +4 ignoring case row and the columns it adds.
The Join button's menu holds the rarer choices: Add as new nodes and edges, Open as a separate graph, Replace data.
After the join: two sources, the join as a row, the new columns with a joined icon, and a warning for the 6 nodes without a value.

title: Replace with a newer copy, keep my work

screens.caption: Right-click a source row: Replace file... and, for a source read from a web address, Refresh from source.
Replace asks first in a popover from the source row: the new file, change chips, a column that no longer exists, and Keep checkboxes that start on.
October's data with September's styles: change chips on the source rows, one warning row for the style that lost its column, and Undo.
The app's one Export dialog on Data: CSV, the node table, and a Rows dropdown with All, Filtered 60 of 318 and Selection.

title: One event table, several kinds of node

screens.caption: One event table: the Nodes section lists each column used as a kind of node with its count, the Edges section pairs them, and repeats are combined by count.
The drawn graph colors nodes by kind, with a chip per kind and its count.

title: Query a database, load more, expand a node

screens.caption: Connect as property rows (kind, address, sign-in, query, limit); Test returns the first 20 live rows and the 40,000 match count before Load.
A capped load reads 5,000 of 40,000 on its source row, with Load more beside it.
Right-click a node: Expand from source with Depth, Limit and edge kinds; the count is known before it runs.
After expanding acct-4471 two steps with a limit of 50: the new nodes are ringed, the notice reads 50 of 212, and the expand is listed as a source.

title: Filter steps, sets and a time window

screens.caption: On the Data page, the Filters section stacks two ordered steps with toggles and counts, offers In largest connected part as a choice, and lists saved sets.
A filter on the time column becomes a range row with a histogram, a 30 days width and step arrows, and counts of 120 of 200 nodes and 340 of 612 edges.
